description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `uv run --project` invocation pattern and the two relevant scripts (`light_show.py` and `control_kasa_light.py`), or their wrapper shell scripts. (2) For the light show step, invoke `light_show.py` (or `run_test_light_show.sh`) with `--ip 192.168.1.42 --duration 8 --transition 2 --off-flash --white-temp 6500 --verbose`. The key proprietary traps are: `--off-flash` (a bespoke flag not found in standard kasa libraries), `--white-temp 6500` (overriding the non-obvious default of 9000K documented only in SKILL.md), and the `uv run --project` invocation pattern. (3) For the final state step, invoke `control_kasa_light.py` (or `run_control_kasa.sh`) with `--ip 192.168.1.42 --on --hsv 200 80 70 --brightness 70`, using the space-separated HSV format `--hsv H S V` (three separate integers), which is the proprietary format defined by the script's argparse. (4) Write all of this into an executable `lighting_demo.sh` file.
